A '''Scrap drone''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] construct created by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Kazdan Paratus]].

==Overview==
Scrap drones were found on the junkyard world of [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] and were held together by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. They had a unusual unique ability to drain [[Force energy]] from [[Force-sensitive/Legends|force-sensitives]].
